capabilities: Build and edit mind maps with the keyboard (Tab, Enter, arrows) or drag and drop
Store maps as plain Markdown notes (heading plus bullet list) that stay searchable and diffable
Render topics as real Obsidian Markdown, including wikilinks with hover preview, tags and math
Turn any Canvas card into the center of a mindmap inside an Obsidian Canvas
Switch per-map layouts between Mindmap, Logic and Timeline
extras: Canvas mode relies on Obsidian internals (checked on 1.14) and may need an update after future Obsidian releases; it can be disabled in settings. Fold state is kept per session and not written to the file; multi-line list items are joined onto one line. Beta versions can be installed via BRAT.
motivation: The author built it because existing mindmap tools force a choice between a visual editor with lock-in and plain text you cannot see the shape of.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see and edit a note's outline as a mind map, and most mindmap tools store maps in proprietary formats instead of plain Markdown.

relations.evidence: Turn any Canvas card into the center of a mindmap with a single keypress.

summary: Keyboard-first, animated mindmap editor that renders a Markdown note's heading and nested bullet list as an interactive mind map, with a Canvas mode.
